# package sparkplugb

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-sparkplugb"
```

Package sparkplugb holds what the edge, host and app packages of this Sparkplug B module share: the Logger and FieldLogger they log through and the RetryPolicy, such as ExponentialBackoff, that decides reconnection.

## Types

### type ExponentialBackoff

```go
type ExponentialBackoff struct {
	// Initial is the delay after the first failure; 500 ms when zero.
	Initial time.Duration
	// Max caps the delay; 30 s when zero.
	Max time.Duration
	// Attempts is the number of retries; 5 when zero, unbounded when
	// negative.
	Attempts int
	// NoJitter waits the delay itself, for tests.
	NoJitter bool
}
```

ExponentialBackoff is the RetryPolicy that retries after a delay that doubles from Initial up to Max, with jitter: the wait is drawn at random between half of the delay and the delay, so that devices that failed together do not come back together.

The zero value retries up to 5 times from 500 ms (Attempts 5, Initial 500 ms, Max 30 s).

#### func (ExponentialBackoff) Delay

```go
func (b ExponentialBackoff) Delay(attempt int) time.Duration
```

Delay returns the wait after the failure of attempt, regardless of the error and of Attempts.

#### func (ExponentialBackoff) ShouldRetry

```go
func (b ExponentialBackoff) ShouldRetry(attempt int, err error) (bool, time.Duration)
```

ShouldRetry implements RetryPolicy.

### type FieldLogger

```go
type FieldLogger interface {
	Logger
	With(kv ...any) FieldLogger
}
```

FieldLogger is a Logger that keeps fields (key-value pairs) with its lines: With returns one that adds kv to every line. The packages of this module name themselves (component=edge, ...) through it when a Logger is one.

#### func NewSlogLogger

```go
func NewSlogLogger(h slog.Handler) FieldLogger
```

NewSlogLogger returns a FieldLogger that writes to the slog handler h, at the slog levels of the same names.

#### func NewStdLogger

```go
func NewStdLogger(l *log.Logger, debug bool) FieldLogger
```

NewStdLogger returns a Logger that writes to l (the standard logger when nil), with the level in front of each line, from Info up; NewStdLogger with debug true writes Debug lines too.

### type Logger

```go
type Logger interface {
	Debugf(format string, args ...any)
	Infof(format string, args ...any)
	Warnf(format string, args ...any)
	Errorf(format string, args ...any)
}
```

Logger receives the log of the edge nodes, host applications and applications of this module: set it as the Logger of their configuration. A nil Logger logs nothing. Debug is the detail of every publish and subscribe; Info, what changes (a state transition, a rebirth); Warn, what failed and is retried; Error, what fails a call or stops work.

A Logger is called from many goroutines, and must not block.

#### func ComponentLogger

```go
func ComponentLogger(l Logger, name string) Logger
```

ComponentLogger returns the Logger a package of this module uses for l: NopLogger for nil, and for a FieldLogger one with component=name.

#### func NopLogger

```go
func NopLogger() Logger
```

NopLogger returns a Logger that logs nothing.

### type RetryPolicy

```go
type RetryPolicy interface {
	ShouldRetry(attempt int, err error) (retry bool, wait time.Duration)
}
```

RetryPolicy decides whether a failed connection or publish is made again, and when: the edge nodes, host applications and applications of this module take one for their reconnection. attempt is the number of the attempt that failed, from 0. A policy is called from many goroutines.

#### func NoRetry

```go
func NoRetry() RetryPolicy
```

NoRetry returns a RetryPolicy that never retries.
